properties.name: label
properties.description: Accessible label for the truncation toggle that opens the popover with the hidden breadcrumb items.

design.note: In code the collapsed Breadcrumb Items are placed in the default slot and rendered inside the popover's list. In Figma the popover content is built from the helper component 🛟 Breadcrumb Popover List Item instead of a slot on this component.

design.name: 🔄 Separator
design.note: Figma swaps the separator on the item (🛟 Breadcrumb Separator, Chevron Right or Slash). In code there is no item-level property; `separator` is set once on the breadcrumb and applies to the whole trail.

No variant property in Figma. Small and Medium are modelled as separate component sets (↳ Breadcrumb Popover Item → (Def) Small and → Medium). In code the item inherits the size from the breadcrumb, which writes it as data-size.

design.name: 🔀 Interaction State
design.note: Figma-only. Documents the visual states of the truncation; in code these are the native interaction states of the underlying button and are not a property.
